interactive.label: Load stack
interactive.tooltip: Load a 2-D TIFF image or a 3-D TIFF bead stack (or drop the file on the window).

interactive.label: Demo stack
interactive.tooltip: Replace the stack by a generated one with five beads of known size (a demo, not data).

interactive.label: MMFDB dataset
interactive.tooltip: Select a registered TIFF dataset from the MMFDB catalog.

interactive.label: Detect
interactive.tooltip: Find beads using the adaptive quantile threshold and the separation filters.

interactive.label: Fit selected
interactive.tooltip: Fit a 3-D Gaussian to the clicked or selected bead.

interactive.label: Fit all
interactive.tooltip: Fit every detected bead and report the complete batch including failures.

interactive.label: Export CSV
interactive.tooltip: Refit and export all detected beads with physical widths and fit quality.

interactive.label: Save settings
interactive.tooltip: Save calibration, ROI, detection and display settings to JSON.

interactive.label: Load settings
interactive.tooltip: Restore settings and reopen the stored source stack when available.

interactive.label: Help
interactive.tooltip: Explain how a bead stack gives the PSF and what to check.

interactive.label: Guide
interactive.tooltip: Walk through loading, detection, fitting and the checks.

interactive.label: pixel_size_nm
interactive.tooltip: Lateral camera/scanner pixel size in nm; scales σx/σy to physical FWHM.

interactive.label: z_step_nm
interactive.tooltip: Axial distance between z-slices in nm; scales σz to physical FWHM.

interactive.label: roi_xy
interactive.tooltip: Lateral ROI size (pixels) cut around a bead for the 3D Gaussian fit.

interactive.label: roi_z
interactive.tooltip: Axial ROI size (slices) cut around a bead for the 3D Gaussian fit.

interactive.label: pixels_per_frame
interactive.tooltip: Expected bright pixels per frame; sets the adaptive quantile threshold for bead detection.

interactive.label: min_distance
interactive.tooltip: Minimum lateral distance between accepted beads (pixels); rejects clustered candidates.

interactive.label: min_area
interactive.tooltip: Smallest connected bright region that can be a bead. A bead covers several pixels; a single one is a hot camera pixel. Set to 1 to keep every speck.

interactive.label: bead_index
interactive.tooltip: Zero-based index of the detected bead; selecting a bead fits it and opens its z slice.

interactive.label: x profile
interactive.tooltip: Inspect the measured x profile and Gaussian fit through the bead center.

interactive.label: y profile
interactive.tooltip: Inspect the measured y profile and Gaussian fit through the bead center.

interactive.label: z profile
interactive.tooltip: Inspect the measured z profile and Gaussian fit through the bead center.

interactive.label: Z slice
interactive.tooltip: Browse the axial stack; image picks and bead overlays refer to this slice.

interactive.label: Colormap
interactive.tooltip: Color scale of the image; pixel values and fits remain unchanged.

interactive.label: Display gamma
interactive.tooltip: Lift dim structures with gamma above one; display changes do not affect detection or fitting.

interactive.label: Automatic levels
interactive.tooltip: Map the minimum and maximum finite image values to the color range.

interactive.label: Reset view
interactive.tooltip: Restore the full-image view after zooming or panning.

interactive.label: Display minimum
interactive.tooltip: Set the lower display level without changing stored pixel values.

interactive.label: Display maximum
interactive.tooltip: Set the upper display level without changing stored pixel values.
